one_line_description: Fathom is an AI-powered note-taking service that captures, transcribes, and summarizes Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls. It offers a free tier for individuals and paid plans for teams with CRM integration, delivering searchable, editable meeting notes and actionable insights.
